images.title: Square of a difference in one picture
images.purpose: Recaps the square of a difference: from a², take away two a by b strips and add back the b² corner.
images.composition: One large square centred, the same strip picture in letters, with the identity underneath. Plain white background, lots of empty space around the main object, no scenery, no people, no extra text.
images.exact_structure: A large square of side a with a dark outline; the label 'a' centred above it. Inside, a teal (#0072B2) square in the top left corner labelled 'a − b' along its left side. A strip of width b down the full right side and a strip of height b along the full bottom, both with thin vermilion (#D55E00) diagonal hatching; each strip carries the label '− ab' just outside it. The b by b bottom right overlap is reddish purple (#CC79A7), labelled '+ b²'. A small 'b' marks the width of the right strip. Below the square, centred, the label '(a − b)² = a² − 2ab + b²'. Exactly 1 teal square, 2 hatched strips, 1 corner square.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: To square a difference, take away 2ab and add back b².
images.description: Recaps the square of a difference: from a², take away two a by b strips and add back the b² corner.

image_decisions.why: The practice squares 99 and 58 as round numbers minus small ones; this recap image shows the rule to use without giving away either answer.
